summary: MARA Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its subsidiary, MARA USA Corporation, entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of Long Ridge Energy Power LLC for a base purchase price of ~$1.5 billion, subject to customary adjustments. The transaction will make Long Ridge an indirect wholly owned subsidiary. The filing includes an investor presentation as Exhibit 99.1 for additional details. No board recommendation, advisors, or specific terms like premium or break fee are mentioned. The deal is subject to third-party approvals and customary closing conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential timeline updates; risk-arb focus on completion certainty and financing.
